[F002] Summary:

Implemented F002 — the HTML renderer for the architecture map. Added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_html.py` (single-file, no-JS-framework, self-contained dark-theme HTML with three deterministic inline SVG diagrams: module dependency graph from `modules[].imports`, plan lifecycle state machine annotated with status counts, and the 8-state supervisor state machine) plus an `ArchitectureRenderError` that always points back to `dontpanic architecture regen`. Wired `--with-html` (default) and `--json-only` mutually-exclusive flags into the existing `architecture regen` subcommand, with an optional `--html-output` override. Added 17 fixture tests in `tests/test_architecture_html_f002.py` covering happy-path rendering, missing/invalid/malformed JSON errors, HTML5 well-formedness (stdlib `HTMLParser`-based balanced-tag + single-document probe), all three SVG-diagram presence assertions (with edge/node/state-label invariants), and the CLI end-to-end paths (default writes both files; `--json-only` skips the HTML; `--html-output` override).
